enabled.description: Whether to enable the princeprocessor wrapper.

wordlist.description: Path to the input wordlist file.

output_file.description: Output file for generated candidates. Use '-' for stdout.

elem_cnt_min.description: Minimum number of elements per chain (elem-cnt-min).

elem_cnt_max.description: Maximum number of elements per chain (elem-cnt-max).

wl_max.description: Load only this many words from the wordlist. 0 to disable.

skip.description: Skip this many passwords from start (for distributed).

limit.description: Limit output to this many passwords (for distributed).

case_permute.description: Enable case permutation for words starting with a letter.

dupe_check_disable.description: Disable duplicate checking for faster initial load.
